srList.sentence: Due to the inclusion of both eyes of some patients, statistical analyses comparing the femtosecond group to the conventional treatment group, as well as assessing the influence of risk factors, were conducted using Generalized estimating equation (GEE) models (IBM SPSS Statistics version 22, Armonk NY) employing exchangeable correlation structure and interval, binomial, or multinomial links as appropriate.
